title: David Flynn's Cydonia book reprinted by his daughter

tellings.quote: That book was that book before Flynn's daughter reprinted it. It was going for two and $3,000.

plain: A book called Cydonia by a writer named David Flynn, named after an area on Mars, was once so hard to find that copies sold for two to three thousand dollars, until Flynn's daughter reprinted it. The guest Tim Alberino says this from his own experience of the book, as a sign of how sought-after it was.
